description: A 52-mile long bridge of brittle wood. You feel an overwhelming urge to say 'blah' every five minutes.

onEnter.message: Barry suddenly appears and snatches the Magnifying Glass! 'WHOOPS!' he screeches, dropping it into the Chasm of Chaos!

exit_west.description: A stone archway leading back down to the Great Farm.

chasm_of_chaos.description: An bottomless void stretching into absolute darkness. Blah echoes from its depths.

barry.description: Barry is blocking the way, looking smug.

dialogue.text: "Your perseverance annoys me!" Barry sneers, deformed and sparking wildly. "You thought you were so cool, with your magnifying glass thingy! Well, whoops!" He grabs the Magnifying Glass and drops it into the Chasm of Chaos! Willy screeches: "NOOOO! Not my magnifying glass again! I have to order another one off of-" "So take a seat!" Barry interrupts.
"Oh, that's it!" snaps Freddista. She rushes over to Barry, grabs him by his melted terminals, and hurls him into the deep abyss of the Chasm of Chaos!

locked_gate.description: A heavy iron gate blocks the way back to Shoeboxlandia. It requires Chapter 2 to open.

conditions.failMessage: The gate is locked tight. The path to Shoeboxlandia will open in Chapter 2.
